sv.title: Trump väcker handelsstriden till liv – så drabbas EU av nya tullar
sv.summary: USA:s president Donald Trump har återigen skärpt tonen i handelspolitiken. På onsdagen föreslog hans administration nya tullar mot 14 handelspartner, däribland EU. USA vill med tullarna motverka ”strukturell överskottskapacitet” i industrin.

en.title: Trump revives trade war – how the EU is hit by new tariffs
en.summary: US President Donald Trump has once again sharpened the tone in trade policy. On Wednesday his administration proposed new tariffs against 14 trading partners, including the EU. The US wants the tariffs to counter ”structural overcapacity” in industry.
